title: Giant Mountain Peaks Swallowed Earth's Greenhouse Gas
description: Discover how the rise of the Himalayas reshaped our global climate. This massive tectonic collision did more than build peaks—it acted as a colossal chemical sponge. Learn the silent planetary mechanism that cooled our world down.
instagram_caption: The earth has its own powerful ways of cooling down runaway heat. Watch how the rising Himalayas altered our global climate forever.

segments.narration: These towering stone peaks look completely frozen, but they actively inhale global carbon.
broll_queries: mountain peak snow blowing close up

segments.narration: Millions of years ago, a suffocating greenhouse heat trapped the entire planet.
broll_queries: hot hazy primeval forest wide shot

segments.narration: Then, two massive tectonic plates collided with unimaginable, slow-motion power.
The violent crash pushed raw, fresh minerals high into the sky.
Heavy monsoon rains began washing over these newly exposed rock faces.

segments.narration: A quiet chemical reaction stripped carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere.

segments.narration: Raging rivers carried these dissolved minerals straight into the deep ocean.
broll_queries: raging muddy river rushing close up

segments.narration: The trapped carbon settled onto the seabed, locking away the greenhouse heat.

segments.narration: This massive chemical drain permanently cooled the entire surface of the Earth.
